title: Should we fear chatbots?
questions: What are the main ideas you learned from this episode? Please give a brief summary in your own words.
What exactly about chatbots should worry people most: misinformation, job loss, privacy, dependency, or something else?
When is it acceptable to rely on a chatbot for advice, and when should a human be involved?
Should people always be told when they are communicating with an AI rather than a person?
Could frequent use of chatbots weaken some human skills?
What rule would you introduce first if you were responsible for regulating chatbots?
